Sheffield SaaS firm Loamweave raises £1.1m to automate farm compliance

Loamweave, a Sheffield-based vertical SaaS company, has raised £1.1 million in a seed round led by a Northern venture fund.

Its platform automates farm compliance paperwork, and the startup says it has cut inspection preparation time by half for its 120 agricultural customers.

The round, announced on Tuesday, values the company at £8 million and will fund a second product line for livestock assurance.
